user.title: ThemeParks.wiki
user.description: Live wait times, park hours and showtimes from ThemeParks.wiki. An API key is optional: without one, requests are limited per IP address. You can create a key at {url}.

data_description.api_key: Leave empty to use the API without a key.

parks.title: Choose parks
parks.description: Pick the parks at {destination} to track. You can change this later in the integration's options.

legacy.title: Take over the old Theme Parks integration
legacy.description: {count} entities from the old Theme Parks integration ({old}) match this resort. Turn this on to give the new entities the same entity IDs, names, areas, labels, aliases and voice exposure, and keep their history. The old integration's entry is removed so its entity IDs are free; its files stay installed until you remove them in HACS.

data.take_over_legacy: Take over entity IDs and remove the old integration

reconfigure.title: API key
reconfigure.description: This entry currently uses {current}. Enter a new key to replace it, or leave the field empty to keep the current one.

data.remove_api_key: Remove the API key and use the API without one

reauth_confirm.title: ThemeParks.wiki rejected the API key
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new API key, or leave it empty to use the API without one.

error.rate_limited: ThemeParks.wiki is rate limiting requests right now. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: This resort is already set up.

data_description.include_shows: Create a sensor for each show, with its showtimes as attributes.
data_description.include_restaurants: Create a sensor for each restaurant that reports a wait.
data_description.include_other: Attractions that belong to the resort but to no park, such as those at Disney Springs.
data_description.calendars: One calendar per park with opening hours, extra hours and ticketed events for the next 30 days.
data_description.live_interval: ThemeParks.wiki refreshes live data every 60 seconds, so a shorter interval returns the same data.
data_description.schedule_interval: Park hours change rarely; once an hour is plenty.
